summary: Grant County, OR former lookout in the Wallowa-Whitman NF, about 10 miles NE of Granite; dated only to the 1930s, listed abandoned and gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned and gone; no source read describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one directory entry (firelookout.com) gives the location, elevation and 1930s era; the FFLA list and Forest Lookouts confirm the name, county and status only. No builder, design, height, staffing, fire or demolition details were found in any source read, so none are stated. Name clash: the FFLOS 'Badger Butte Lookout Site' (US 563, Hood River County, 44.87, -121.70, built around 1933) is a different lookout; its panoramas and history must not be attached to this record. The Forest Service archive record (forestservicemuseum.pastperfectonline.com) returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Record kind 'unknown' is left as is; no correction proposed. Budget: 2 WebSearch, 3 page reads, 1 failed archive fetch.
